recipe_inventory.label: Typical ethylenediamine procedure

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 2310), Experimental Section

recipe_inventory.scope: 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave; ethylenediamine up to 80% total volume; maintained at 140 °C for 12 h; air-cooled, filtered, washed and vacuum-dried. Source specifies appropriate amounts only; S, Se, or Te are alternatives, not one combined charge.
gaps: No reagent masses, moles, ratios, pressure, ramp, stirring, cooling duration, wash amounts/concentration/count, vacuum level, or isolated yield.
The article does not establish each chalcogen as a separate 140 °C/12 h batch.

gaps: Amounts, ratios, vessel type/capacity/fill, closure, pressure, batch identifiers and yield remain unreported for the captioned variants.
The generic ethylenediamine procedure is not used to supply vessel/fill details to alternative-solvent captions.

qualitative_contexts.label: Trien morphology context
qualitative_contexts.statement: The authors say CdS prepared in dien and trien under the same experimental conditions display the same rod-like morphology; CdSe rods are also mentioned for dien or trien. No separate trien condition, dimension, figure or physical batch is supplied.
qualitative_contexts.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed p. 2311), Results and Discussion, polyamine paragraphs

qualitative_contexts.label: Lower-temperature comparison
qualitative_contexts.statement: Below 120 °C the reaction is described as unfavorable and potentially incomplete or unable to occur; no additional recipe is specified.
qualitative_contexts.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3 (printed p. 2311), Results and Discussion, lower-temperature paragraph

qualitative_contexts.label: CdS absorption interpretation
qualitative_contexts.statement: Authors interpret the 485 nm CdS/en absorption relative to bulk absorption above 500 nm as a blue shift indicative of size quantization.
